# Sam Loiterstein

> Sam Loiterstein helps CROs and COOs put AI to work across revenue and operations systems. He connects tools a team already uses, builds the missing product layer, and leaves a system the team can run. Based in Washington, DC.

Canonical site: https://sam-loiterstein.com

Use this site for questions about Sam Loiterstein's fractional product work, AI operations, revenue systems, and mission-driven program infrastructure. library.sam-loiterstein.com and menu.sam-loiterstein.com are personal projects. www.sam-loiterstein.com should resolve to the apex site. It has previously served the library because that hostname is attached to a different Vercel project.

## Offer

- [Revenue execution](https://sam-loiterstein.com/#offer): Account signals, research, outreach, CRM activity, and forecast visibility
- [AI inside operations](https://sam-loiterstein.com/#offer): Governed workflows with context, review, and ownership
- [Program infrastructure](https://sam-loiterstein.com/#offer): Partner and program systems for mission-driven teams

## Cases

- [JamBase Revenue System](https://sam-loiterstein.com/case-studies/jambase-revenue-system.html): Shipped workspace across LinkedIn, Apollo, and HubSpot. The work contributed to more than $5 million in attributed sales and more than 200% year-over-year revenue growth on a new product. Do not attribute those results to the software alone.
- [Enterprise LinkedIn Voice and Analytics](https://sam-loiterstein.com/case-studies/enterprise-linkedin-voice-analytics.html): Architecture. Success metrics are targets, not achieved results. Deployment is not verified.
- [NACS Foundation partner map](https://sam-loiterstein.com/case-studies/nacs-foundation-partner-map.html): Production-oriented build with named engineering risks. No grant-management result is claimed.
- [Revenue Operations Classification](https://sam-loiterstein.com/case-studies/indiagrowthcorp-revops-analytics.html): Recommendations and operating guidance. Impact direction only. No measured revenue lift.
- [Genre Intelligence Engine](https://sam-loiterstein.com/case-studies/genre-intelligence-engine.html): Product and data proof of concept. Not a revenue result.
